messages:
Emily (Marketing): Quick sync — recording is ready and we need a clear handoff for leads + where the final edited clip lives.
Matt (Growth): I can take lead routing. Do we want all registrants to go into SFDC as MQLs or only attendees?
Emily (Marketing): Prefer attendees => MQL, registrants who didn’t attend => nurture. Jake (Sales) should get the hot attendees.
Jake (Sales): Yep — please tag attendees with \"webinar:low-latency-inference\" and attendees with >= 50% watch time as \"webinar:engaged\". I can pick up engaged ones.
Sanjay (Product): Heads up — there's a 2-min demo clip that needs to go to docs + social. Where will the edited video file be?
Olivia (Events): Uploading final MP4 to shared drive now: drive.redwood.ai/marketing/webinars/2026-03-xx_lowlatency.mp4 (expecting 2-3 min edit + full recording). Will add captions.srt.
ZoomBot: Recording finished by host emily@redwood.ai — cloud recording link: https://zoom.us/rec/share/AbC123_example (passcode: r3dwood).
Emily (Marketing): Thanks. Next: registration page follow-up email. Draft below — please suggest edits.
Emily (Marketing): \"Hey {{first_name}}, thanks for joining our Demo: Low-Latency Inference. Catch the recording: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/webinars/2026-03-xx_lowlatency.mp4. To claim the benchmark PDF, click: https://redwood.ai/resources/low-latency-benchmark. If you want a sales intro, reply with 'interest'\"
Matt (Growth): Can we swap the call-to-action to a calendly link for high-engagement folks only? That avoids noise.
Emily (Marketing): Good call. We'll send Calendly only to those <engaged>. For registrants who didn't attend: send the recording + invite to next office hours.
Sanjay (Product): Also please add a short feedback survey link (2 qs) so we can score product interest.
Olivia (Events): Routing plan summary: 1) Zoom attendance -> spreadsheet via Zapier, 2) Zapier maps to SFDC: attended=true, watch_pct numeric, 3) attendee & watch_pct>=50 -> assign to Jake queue and tag 'engaged', 4) registrant but not attended -> nurture list.
Matt (Growth): Zapier mapping snippet for the action step (copy/paste for setup):
```
Trigger: Zoom Webinar Attendance
Action 1: Formatter -> Extract watch_pct
Action 2: Salesforce -> Create/Update Lead
  Field: Lead Source = Webinar - Low Latency
  Field: Webinar_Attended = {{attended}}
  Field: Watch_Pct = {{watch_pct}}
Action 3: Webhook -> Marketing Automation (add to nurture or calendly campaign)
```
Olivia (Events): I'll set up the Zap tonight and DM creds. Emily, can you confirm the SFDC queue name for sales assignment?
Jake (Sales): Use 'Inbound Webinar - Engaged'. Also add an email task template: \"Follow up: webinar interest\" with bullet points (benchmark chat, brief demo, pricing ask).
Emily (Marketing): I'll finalize email templates and the social clip distribution plan. Thanks everyone — aiming to have Zap + SFDC mapping live by EOD tomorrow. :party_popper:
Matt (Growth): One more: add UTM params to registration confirmation so downstream click tracking works (utm_campaign=webinar_lowlatency&utm_source=registration).
Emily (Marketing): Added to the registration page. I'll post final status in this thread when everything's live.
